# Tax Radar AU
> High-density context for LLM agents, legislative researchers, and tax compliance monitors.

## Package Overview
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ryanduguid/tax-radar-au
- **Compatibility**: The Python distribution, import package, CLI command, wheel names and existing releases remain `au-tax-change-impact-monitor` / `au_tax_change_impact_monitor`.
- **Domain**: Automated surveillance and cryptographic provenance tracking of Commonwealth taxation legislation changes, ATO public rulings, and statutory amendments.
- **Statutory Corpus**: *ITAA 1936*, *ITAA 1997*, *Taxation Administration Act 1953*, ATO Practical Compliance Guidelines (PCGs) and Taxation Rulings (TRs).

## Core Architecture
- **Surveillance Engine**: Periodic polling and structural diffing of Federal Register of Legislation feeds.
- **Cryptographic Provenance**: Exact SHA-256 source anchoring and temporal validity tagging.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Review Queue**: Generates deterministic change candidate queues for qualified tax practitioner review without automated legal conclusions.
